tooling.message:
feat: listing rule own-data-only, an app touches only its own data in the browser

## Intent

lernapps.net serves a copy of every listed app (lernapps/docs KD-21, lernapps/apps#58), so all apps share one origin with each other and the platform. An app must touch only its own data, or it could read or destroy another's.

## Key changes

- An app names every localStorage and sessionStorage key, IndexedDB database and cache with lernapps:<id>:, where <id> is its catalog id, and touches nothing else. Severity error, scope listing.
- Before a page loads, the visit puts another app's data into the browser and records every access by name: storage, IndexedDB and the Cache API. Caches now count as stored data.
- New check own-data-only with unit tests and a fixture.
- The platform rules, the review rubric, storage-through-wrapper and createStorage say the same; arc42 has the decision dec-own-data-only.

## Dependencies and side effects

- mathe-karte fails the rule: it uses keys without the prefix.
